title: Vessel Farm Rising
author: Edmund Zhou
blurb: Kestrel Okafor, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
